edition_scope: English Rules 2.0 (2016), including zero-survivor erratum; complete 6–12 player base game
verdict_basis: No material inaccurate claim or omission relative to the supplied complete authoritative booklet was found. All voting instructions and all nine ordered Showdown outcomes agree with the source. PASS assesses summary fidelity; it does not certify the source as an exhaustive executable specification.

checked_claims.claim: Metadata: player count, duration and designers
Component counts: 12 IDs and stands; 12 sets of 12 voting cards; 80 gold cards; two sets of three Showdown cards
Gold denominations and frequencies: 26×3, 43×4, 11×5
Voting set has 11 other-color target cards plus own-color Ambush
Visible ID setup; remove unused colors; deck and central four face down; Showdown sets aside
Repeated votes among survivors, followed by new round with all players restored
One survivor receives all four central cards; two enter Showdown
Zero survivors: only players absent from final vote get one card from deck; central four carry over with no additions
Conspire before each vote for approximately 90 seconds maximum; any communication method
Game owner calls final decisions; each player places a face-down target or Ambush card in front of self; changes until reveal; simultaneous reveal
Ignore Ambush in tally; all highest-vote ties are targets
Targets and players who voted for no target eliminated, subject to successful Ambush; knock down their IDs
Successful Ambush protects its target-player and eliminates exactly one voter for that player; unsuccessful Ambush self-eliminates
Red Ambush / Yellow votes Red / Pink votes Yellow: Red and Yellow tied, Red and Pink survive
Showdown discussion, one choice from each finalist’s three-card set, face-down choices, simultaneous reveal
Share/Share = 2/2 central cards
Share/Steal = 0/4 central cards (reverse = 4/0)
Share/Grab One & Go = 3/1 central cards (reverse = 1/3)
Steal/Grab One & Go = 3/1 central cards (reverse = 1/3)
Steal/Steal = 0/0 finalists, one deck card to every other player, four central cards retained
Grab One & Go/Grab One & Go = 1/1, two central cards retained and only two new cards added
Other Showdown outcomes award all four; central pool restored to four for ordinary next round
Rewards count cards with variable values, rather than fixed point amounts
Check after round rewards for every ending; at least 25 points for 6–9 or 24 for 10–12
Highest qualifying total wins; tied leaders have repeated extra Showdowns until a single table player has highest total
Hidden-value central dealing does not itself specify later visibility of received gold
No official three-or-more tied-leader procedure, all-Ambush zero-vote procedure, or supply instruction for extra tie Showdown pot

visual_checks.details: Verified title, designers, 6–12 players and 45–60 minute play time.
Verified social collusion, unrestricted communication, elimination and surviving to collect gold.

Verified all component counts and denominations, 11 target cards plus own-color Ambush in each voting set, visible ID cards and stands, unused colors removed, face-down deck and four hidden-value central cards.

Verified one/two/zero survivor branches, revised zero-survivor recipients and deck origin, no central refill in that case, thresholds by player count, highest-total comparison and repeated tie Showdowns, roughly 90-second conspiracy and unrestricted covert/overt communication.

Read the entire voting procedure visually: face-down card in front of its owner, no turn order, changes allowed before reveal, simultaneous reveal, most-voted targets including all ties, elimination for not voting for a target, knocked-down IDs.

Verified tied-target elimination illustration, successful Ambush protection and one attacking-voter retaliation, failed Ambush self-elimination, no Ambush votes counted, and exact three-player Red/Yellow/Pink example.
Verified 4 Blue versus 3 Purple example, failed Emerald Ambush, successful Blue Ambush, restricted retaliation, two finalists with one three-card set each, and Share/Steal/Grab One & Go descriptions.

visual_checks.area: Complete Final Showdown table and end of round
visual_checks.details: Visually read all six unordered pairings (covering all nine ordered matrix cells), both special payout/carryover notes, end-of-round checking after every outcome, thresholds and restoration of all players.

pdf_inspection.method: Read complete authoritative OCR text; visually inspected every supplied source-page image, with special attention to page 5 and every page 8 matrix pairing; opened the PDF using pypdf and inspected its page/image structure. The PDF is image based, and page 5 has no embedded text, so visual evidence was essential.

source_executability_assessment.ordinary_positive_vote_two_finalist_play: The booklet supports the ordinary voting, Ambush, reward and two-finalist procedures, subject to the explicit mechanical omissions below.

source_gaps.trigger: Every survivor chooses Ambush, producing zero counted votes.
source_gaps.gap: The text excludes Ambush from voting totals but does not say whether zero votes produce no Target or make everyone tied for most votes. On the latter reading every Ambush would qualify, yet no ambusher has an attacking voter to eliminate. The prescribed resolution is therefore not determinate.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Explicitly disclosed as unresolved; no invented outcome.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher ruling specifying zero-vote Target determination, Ambush resolution and resulting survivor count.

source_gaps.trigger: Three or more players share the highest qualifying gold total.
source_gaps.gap: Page 4 tells tied players to conduct another Final Showdown, while components and all instructions provide only a two-player Showdown. No multiway pairing, sequence, elimination or reward rule is given.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher procedure for three-or-more tied leaders and re-evaluation of all totals after the procedure.

source_gaps.trigger: An extra game-end tie Showdown is required, including after the round pot was fully awarded or left only partly filled.
source_gaps.gap: The booklet orders another Showdown but does not specify the source, size or timing of its central pot. Ordinary next-round replenishment and retained-gold notes do not explicitly supply an immediate tie Showdown, nor explain repeated tie Showdowns.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Explicitly disclosed; ordinary round refill instructions are not presented as a new official tie-pot rule.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher ruling establishing the pot for each extra tie Showdown and any replenishment between repeated tie Showdowns.

source_gaps.trigger: A voting card or Ambush card has been revealed and another vote or round begins.
source_gaps.gap: The rules provide persistent sets and repeated votes but give no explicit collect/return/discard instruction for revealed voting cards. Reuse is strongly implied by the game structure; its exact timing is unstated.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Does not invent a discard or consumption rule; lacks an explicit recovery instruction because none is supplied by the source.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher sentence specifying that revealed cards return to their owners’ voting sets before subsequent voting and may be reused.

source_gaps.trigger: Hidden central gold is split between recipients or retained after Grab One & Go.
source_gaps.gap: Payout quantities are explicit, but the booklet does not say how specific differently valued hidden cards are assigned or chosen, or exactly when received values must become visible beyond revealing a winning total.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Correctly preserves hidden central dealing and separately notes unspecified publicity of received values; it supplies no invented allocation/drafting rule.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher clarification of card-selection/dealing order and visibility/inspection rules for received gold.
